name: template-nextjs
//esbuild-override: Hoists a single esbuild across nested consumers that declare divergent direct ranges (@esbuild-kit/core-utils ~0.18.20, drizzle-kit ^0.25.4, tsx ~0.28.0 -- vitest itself has no direct esbuild dependency; it reaches esbuild only through vite's peerDependencies range ^0.27.0 || ^0.28.0), which Dependabot's updater cannot regenerate consistently, causing npm ci EUSAGE lockfile-drift failures (see #33, #40). This is a blanket override, not scoped per-consumer: a future dependency needing an incompatible esbuild range will be silently forced to ^0.28.0 instead of surfacing as an install-time conflict -- accepted deliberately (2026-08-08 election) over a narrower per-consumer override. Drop this override once @esbuild-kit/core-utils, drizzle-kit, and tsx each independently declare esbuild ^0.28 (or later) in their own package.json -- at that point npm's normal resolution converges without help.
